description: Search Triptime AI's ready-made, day-by-day travel itineraries (520+ destinations worldwide) by city or country. Use this when the user asks for a trip plan or itinerary for a destination. Returns matching plans with the number of days, places and a link to open the plan on Triptime AI, plus a link to plan a custom trip.

destination.description: City, region or country in English, e.g. "Rome", "Cappadocia", "Japan" (write "Lisbon", not "Lizbon").

language.description: Language for titles and links: the language the user writes in, when it is one of these (optional, default en).

name: search_trip_plans

labels.description: Display labels for the trip card in the requested language.

title: Find ready-made trip plans
